Our products are used on more than 1.5 million active WordPress sites, helping businesses around the world build and manage multilingual websites and content.</p> <p>We’re looking for a technical, hands-on <strong>Technical Paid Advertising Specialist</strong> who knows how to connect AI, automation, and data to real advertising workflows.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <p>This is a role where you’ll have the freedom to build, test, and improve, not just manage campaigns designed by someone else.</p> <p>You’ll own paid advertising hands-on while having the space to explore how AI, automation, and better use of data can improve the way campaigns are managed.</p> <p>You’ll be able to experiment with new tools and approaches, build your own solutions, and directly influence how we develop a more technical and AI-driven approach to paid advertising.</p> <h2>We’d especially like to meet someone who:</h2> <ul> <li> <p>Has personally set up, run, analyzed, and optimized paid campaigns.</p> </li> <li> <p>Has hands-on experience with platforms such as Google Ads, Meta Ads, Microsoft Ads, or LinkedIn Ads.</p> </li> <li> <p>Has used technical tools to automate, connect, analyze, or improve advertising workflows. This could include Google Ads Scripts, advertising APIs, Python, Zapier, Make, GA4, BigQuery, Looker Studio, and AI agents.</p> </li> <li> <p>Is comfortable managing several campaigns or channels at the same time.</p> </li> <li> <p>Can show real examples of using AI or automation to solve advertising problems or reduce manual work.</p> </li> <li> <p>Thinks analytically and enjoys investigating why performance changes, not just reporting that it changed.</p> </li> <li> <p>Understands that automation needs validation and can explain how they check that automated workflows are working correctly.</p> </li> <li> <p>Can work independently, prioritize what needs attention, and move things forward without detailed instructions.</p> </li> <li> <p>Enjoys experimenting with new technology and turning useful ideas into working solutions.</p> </li> </ul> <h2>What we offer</h2> <ul> <li> <p>100% remote position,</p> </li> <li> <p>Body and Mind Movement program to fill you up with energy,</p> </li> <li> <p>A computer budget to make your workplace better,</p> </li> <li> <p>A Kindle device with access to our company Amazon account,</p> </li> <li> <p>We respect national holidays in each country and want you to have a rest these days,</p> </li> <li> <p>Great opportunity to progress and advance,</p> </li> <li> <p>Collaborating with team members across the globe.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>If you enjoy paid advertising as much as you enjoy building smarter ways to run it, we'd love to hear from you. Tell us about the campaigns you've owned and the AI or automation you've built into your work.</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/onthegosystems-paid-ads-specialist">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/onthegosystems-paid-ads-specialist</a></p> Tue, 01 Sep 2026 11:32:09 +0000 Thu, 01 Oct 2026 11:32:09 +0000 https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/onthegosystems-paid-ads-specialist https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/onthegosystems-paid-ads-specialist ZoomInfo Technologies LLC: Manager, Data Platform Anywhere in the World Product Full-Time <p> <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote </p> <div class="content-intro"><p>ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen–fast.</p></div><p>&nbsp;</p> <p>We are seeking an experienced <strong>Manager, Data Platform</strong> to lead the strategy, architecture, and execution of our modern data platform supporting analytics, machine learning, operational systems, and AI-enabled applications. You will be a senior member of the larger AI, Data and Innovation organization, responsible for designing and expanding enterprise-level data infrastructure that enables ZoomInfo's internal teams to interact with data comprehensively. Our core tech stack includes Databricks, Snowflake, AWS, Spark, dbt, Fivetran, Airflow, and BigQuery.</p> <p>This role combines hands-on technical leadership with people management. You will manage, mentor, and develop a team of data platform engineers while remaining deeply engaged in architecture, technical direction, platform reliability, and cross-functional planning.</p> <p>The ideal candidate is a proven team builder who can translate business and stakeholder needs into scalable technical solutions across data engineering, cloud infrastructure, orchestration, governance, and observability.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Technical Strategy &amp; Architecture</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Define and evolve the vision, roadmap, and technical strategy for the data platform.</li> <li>Own architectural decisions across ingestion, transformation, orchestration, storage, serving, governance, and observability.</li> <li>Establish engineering standards and patterns for pipelines, data contracts, infrastructure, and deployment.</li> <li>Evaluate technologies, vendors, and architectural approaches in partnership with stakeholders.</li> <li>Remain hands-on in critical technical initiatives, architecture reviews, prototyping, and complex troubleshooting.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>People Leadership &amp; Management</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Manage, mentor, and develop a team of data platform engineers.</li> <li>Set clear expectations around technical execution, ownership, collaboration, and operational excellence.</li> <li>Support career growth through regular feedback, coaching, and performance management.</li> <li>Participate in hiring, onboarding, interviewing, and team capacity planning.</li> <li>Partner with leadership to define team structure, priorities, and long-term capability needs.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Platform Delive
